long_biography.plain_text:
Contemporary art fills the offices of Christian Dumolin's investment group, Koramic. Works by Panamarenko and Wim Delvoye form part of the surroundings in which he works. Dumolin values artists for the different ways they think and buys works he wants to live with. The group's collection is also shared beyond its headquarters through loans to museums.

On the track, he has become a regular participant in historic motor racing. An initial excursion into rallying with a classic Mercedes led to circuit driving in a Ferrari. He subsequently acquired a Maserati 250F and competed with it at Monaco's historic Grand Prix, returning to an event he had entered repeatedly.

confidence.reason: Actual personal interviews support named artworks, collecting preferences and the Mercedes-to-Ferrari-to-Maserati sequence. Official portfolio page supplies museum loans; the event profile explicitly describes his fourth Monaco participation. No claim of a particular race victory or contemporary Formula One career is made.
